case_title: INDUSIND BANK LTD. Vs RAJANNA
court_name: 28-CCH9 XXVII ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE
judges: CCH18 XIX ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE; 28-CCH9 XXVII ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE; CCH9 XXVII ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE
sections: U/S 276 OF THE INDIAN SUCCESSION ACT
business_text:
DHR absent. Advocate for DHR is also absent. On perusal of order sheet it is clear that even after the sufficient opportunities the DHR did not came forward to proceed with the execution petition. The matter is of the year 2010 and the conduct of the parties shows that, they are not interested in taking steps against JDR. Therefore this court is the opinion that, it is not proper to grant further time to the DHR to proceed with the case. Accordingly I proceed to pass the following ORDER The execution petition filed by the DHR is dismissed for non prosecution. Nature of Disposal : DISMISSED Disposal Date : 17-03-2021 CCH9 XXVII ADDL. CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE

business_list.business_text: DHR absent. Advocate for DHR is also absent. On perusal of order sheet it is clear that even after the sufficient opportunities the DHR did not came forward to proceed with the execution petition. The matter is of the year 2010 and the conduct of the parties shows that, they are not interested in taking steps against JDR. Therefore this court is the opinion that, it is not proper to grant further time to the DHR to proceed with the case. Accordingly I proceed to pass the following ORDER The execution petition filed by the DHR is dismissed for non prosecution. Nature of Disposal : DISMISSED Disposal Date : 17-03-2021 CCH9 XXVII ADDL.
